priority: 先比优先级，再按权重抽取
max_active_groups: HED 同时活跃遭遇上限
load_ceiling: Hold new arrivals at combat load
暂缓新增敌人的战斗负担门槛
capable_min: 至少需要的有效玩家人数
allow_events: 允许在任务事件期间额外投放
status_help: Changes are saved for the next mission. Native spawns still run. HED adds only encounters referenced by enabled deployment rules.
修改保存后于下一局生效。原版刷怪继续运行；HED 只额外安排已启用规则所引用的编队。
empty_help: Start with a formation, then add a deployment rule. Finally enable the director. Templates and HCM multipliers can also be used on their own.
先在编队库选择敌人，再建立投放规则，最后启用导演。原版模板编辑和 HCM 倍率也可以单独使用。
limits_help: Pending and living encounters both occupy this limit. Native permissions, enemy capacity and valid spawn positions can delay an arrival.
待生成与仍有存活成员的遭遇都会占用额度。原版刷怪许可、敌人容量与有效出生位置仍可能延后到场。
phase_help: Adaptive mode cycles through build, pressure and recovery. High load or too few capable players starts recovery early. Recovery waits for its minimum duration and low load.
自适应模式依次经历蓄压、施压、恢复。战斗负担过高或有效玩家过少会提前恢复；恢复须满足最低时长与低负担条件才会结束。
low_load: 结束恢复所需的低负担门槛
high_load: 提前进入恢复的高负担门槛
phase_frequency: 本阶段频率倍率；0 为暂停
phase_only: These settings apply in Adaptive pressure mode.
这些设置仅在自适应模式中参与运行。
seed_help: 0 follows the mission seed. Each deployment has separate timer, variant and member-count streams. Editing another rule does not consume its random sequence.
0 表示沿用任务种子。每条投放的计时、变体、人数分别使用独立随机流；编辑其他规则不会占用它的随机序列。
map_seed_help: The layout seed controls the native roamer layout. It does not change the mission map or seed all native combat systems.
布局种子用于原版驻军布置，不改变任务地图，也不会统一设定所有原版战斗系统的随机数。
seed_limit: Matching seeds and inputs reproduce HED choices. Player movement, native randomness, competing rules and available spawn locations can still change the final encounter.
相同种子与相同输入可复现 HED 的选择。玩家移动、原版随机、规则竞争与可用出生点仍会影响实际战斗。
counts: %d 个编队 · %d 条投放规则
overrides: %d fixed values · %d relative multipliers · %d native rules
%d 项固定值 · %d 项相对倍率 · %d 条原版规则
no_formations: No formations yet. Choose an enemy category and create one.
还没有编队。选择敌人类别并创建编队。
no_deployments: No deployment rules yet. Create a formation first, then choose it here.
还没有投放规则。先创建编队，再在这里选择要调用的编队。
name: Name
名称
name_hint: Up to 48 characters. Enter saves; Escape cancels.
最多 48 个字符。回车保存，Esc 取消。
invalid_name: Enter a name of 1–48 characters without control characters.
请输入 1～48 个字符的名称，不含控制字符。
referenced: Used by %d deployment rules. Remove those rules before deleting this formation.
被 %d 条投放引用；删除编队前须先删除关联规则。
formation_help: One encounter draws one variant by weight. Member ranges are counts, not chances. Each deployment controls its own schedule.
每次遭遇按权重抽取一个变体。成员范围表示人数，不是概率；每条投放规则分别控制到场时机。
formation_limits: Per variant: 300 ordinary troops, 16 specialists or 3 monsters. Runtime admission may reduce or delay the planned force.
每个变体最多 300 名普通敌人、16 名特感或 3 只怪物。运行时的容量和选点限制可能缩减或延后到场。
formation_immutable: Category: %s · create another formation to use a different category
类别：%s · 更换类别请创建另一编队
condition: 条件由不满足变为满足
first_delay: 开局后最早到场时间（秒）
progress_start: 首次触发的推进距离（米）
progress_step: 再次投放所需继续推进距离（米）
end_time: 有效窗口结束时间（秒）；0 为不限
timing_help: Intervals begin after the first accepted member. A condition trigger fires once while its conditions stay true; they must become false before it can fire again.
再次投放的间隔从首名成员被接纳后开始计算。条件触发在持续满足期间只执行一次，必须先变为不满足才能重新触发。
no_conditions: No extra conditions. Native permissions and the director limits still apply.
没有额外条件；原版许可与导演全局限制仍然生效。
condition_help: Native slots already accepted keep their lifecycle. Director limits still apply while HED members wait; expired requests do not pile up.
已被原版槽位接纳的特感沿用原版流程。HED 成员等待时仍受导演全局限制；过期请求不会积压补发。
cooldown: 成功到场后的最短冷却（秒）
max_occurrences: 整局成功遭遇额度；0 为不限
max_alive: 本规则同时活跃遭遇上限
rule_priority: 优先级；数值越高越优先
quota_help: The quota counts encounters with at least one accepted member. It is separate from enemy count, wave count and concurrent encounters. Fixed priority can delay lower-priority rules.
额度统计至少已有一名成员被接纳的遭遇，与人数、波数及同时活跃遭遇数分别计算。固定优先级可能使低优先级规则持续等待。
inherit_size: 跟随 HCM 的成员人数倍率
inherit_frequency: 跟随 HCM 的触发频率
size_multiplier: 在此基础上的人数倍率
frequency_multiplier: 在此基础上的频率倍率
inherit_help: Common horde/trickle members follow their HCM size setting; elites follow Elite members per group. Specialists follow slot capacity; monsters follow encounter count. Patrol ordinary members stay at 1×. Custom waves remain explicit.
普通尸潮／小股成员跟随各自的 HCM 人数倍率，精英跟随敌群精英人数。特感跟随并行容量，怪物跟随遭遇数；巡逻普通成员保持 1×。自定义波数始终由本规则指定。
frequency_help: Horde, trickle and specialist rules follow the matching HCM frequency. Other categories start at 1×. Higher frequency shortens later time or distance intervals; first-arrival and cooldown values stay explicit.
尸潮、小股潮、特感分别跟随对应的 HCM 频率，其他类别从 1× 开始。频率越高，再次投放的时间或距离间隔越短；首次时间与冷却仍使用本规则的明确值。
budget_help: Each HED encounter is bounded to 256 ordinary troops, 16 specialists or 3 monsters across all waves. Native specialist slots and available locations may further limit arrivals.
每次 HED 遭遇的所有波次合计最多 256 名普通敌人、16 名特感或 3 只怪物。原版特感槽位及出生位置仍可能进一步限制到场。
no_changes: No native overrides yet. HCM values are inherited.
尚未覆盖原版字段，当前跟随 HCM。
relative: 在 HCM 结果上乘倍率
relative_help: HCM is applied first, then this multiplier. The field's valid range and integer rounding still apply. Other native mission modifiers may apply afterward.
先计算 HCM，再乘此倍率；仍受字段有效范围和整数取整约束。之后可能继续叠加原版任务修正。
template_help: Choose the source family, then its mode and difficulty branch. Native identifiers are available in details; the numbers here are template values, not guaranteed on-screen counts.
先选刷怪来源，再选模式与难度分支。此处编辑模板数值，不代表保证同屏人数；原版标识可在详情中查看。
legacy_field: No active consumer was confirmed for this field in the audited game version. It is excluded from common controls; editing it may have no effect.
在已核对的游戏版本中，未确认这个字段的实际读取位置。常用参数已排除它；修改可能不产生效果。
reset_native_confirm: 再次点击：清除全部原版覆盖
summary_help: Presets include HCM values, native overrides, formations, deployment rules and both seeds. Version 2 native presets can still be imported.
方案包含 HCM 数值、原版覆盖、编队、投放规则和两类种子。仍支持导入第 2 版原版模板方案。
enabled_rules: 已启用 %d / %d 条投放规则
unreferenced: %d 个编队尚未被投放规则调用
scope_off: 额外编队导演当前关闭
scope_on: Extra director will run next mission
额外编队导演将在下一局运行
common_hint: Common controls are shown first. Use All fields to inspect the complete supported template tree.
默认显示常用参数；切换全部字段可查看受支持的完整模板结构。
scope_pacing: Global pacing selects combat stages and which sources may run. Combat load uses breed threat ratings; tension and expedition heat are separate measures.
全局节奏决定战斗阶段及允许的刷怪来源。战斗负担由兵种威胁评分累加，紧张值与远征热度是另外两套量。
scope_roamers: Roamers are planned by route zones, density, pack selection and per-breed limits. Repeated members are part of a pack's composition, not a probability.
驻军按路线分区、密度、敌群抽取和兵种限制预先布置。敌群内重复的成员表示编成数量，不是兵种抽取概率。
scope_hordes: Hordes combine trigger time or travel, waves, compositions and spawn methods. Member count, wave count and active encounters are separate controls.
尸潮由触发时间或推进距离、波数、编成和出生方式共同组成。成员人数、波数、同时活跃遭遇数分别控制。
scope_specials: Specialists refill slots after completion. Capacity, refill time, same-breed limits and coordinated attacks are separate. Some templates use travel instead of seconds.
特感使用结束后补充的槽位。容量、补充间隔、同类限制与协同攻击分别控制；部分模板用推进距离替代秒数。
scope_monsters: Route monsters use a mission allowance and usable map sections. Scripted bosses and specialist monster replacements are separate.
沿途怪物根据整局额度与可用地图分区安排，与任务脚本 Boss 和特感替换的怪物分别计算。
scope_events: Automatic events spend points on enemy categories. Category weights affect budget allocation, not the final percentage of each breed.
自动事件按点数预算安排敌人类别。类别权重影响预算分配，并不直接等于最终人数占比。
scope_mission_events: Mission events are scripted node sequences. Combat nodes spend points or spawn a named breed. Objective flow continues to follow the mission script.
任务事件是按顺序执行的节点。战斗节点可按点数或指定兵种生成；任务时序与目标流程仍由任务脚本控制。
scope_mutators: Condition templates apply only while that condition is active. Pacing multipliers, extra encounters and enemy buffs are different settings.
词条模板只在对应词条生效时参与运行。节奏倍率、额外遭遇和敌人增益是不同类型的设置。
template_sources: These are template inputs. Difficulty, active conditions and runtime admission can still alter the final result.
这些数值是模板输入；难度、已选词条与运行时接纳条件仍可能影响最终结果。
group_ranged_trickle_forward_horde_push_: 远程小股前压与后方尸潮
recheck_conditions: Continue checking conditions after the first member arrives
首名成员到场后，继续逐项检查附加条件
condition_horde_active: A native horde is being generated
condition_horde_idle: No native horde is being generated
当前没有原版尸潮生成
saved_invalid: Stored HED settings were invalid. Defaults are active; the saved data has not been overwritten.
已保存的 HED 设置无效，当前使用默认设置；原保存数据尚未被覆盖。
navigation_required: Extra encounters need the current Havoc Condition Manager with shared navigation support. Update HCM and restart the game.
额外编队需要带共享寻路支持的当前 HCM。请更新 HCM 并重新启动游戏。
